race.comment: BEDDA MIA (5) win record hardly excites but looks to find her right race today. Got off the mark first up on the Canberra Acton over 1080m. Third up she pulled up with a nasal discharge after finishing eighth over 1100m at Forbes in C2 class. Assess on previous runs. IROQUAI (6) caught the eye on the backup with a slashing third in the heavy conditions over 1000m at Wagga. Gets a similar set up again and must be included. JUNGLE LIGHTS (4) lightly raced mare heading in the right direction. Got off the mark at her second run back, then warmed up nicely to secure third over 1175m at Albury. On the up and sure to be thereabouts. TA LA MASCA (11) sharp drop in weight for this after failing to make an impression with the 58.5kg when last over 1150m at Leeton. Assess on the good run here two back.
